name: Trigger Pulse Lab
description: Run a user-selected controller press command from the Cheats page.
author: Tavros Baker
code: const remove=xlinkWorkshop.addCheat('Trigger Pulse Lab','Run a single test pulse using the command parser.',async()=>{const button=prompt('Button name (e.g. A, RT, RB)','A');if(!button)return;const ms=Math.max(20,Math.min(1000,Number(prompt('Duration in milliseconds','120'))||120));await xlink.command('press '+button.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi,'')+' '+ms)});return remove;
